title: Invest Local or Remote? The Effects of COVID-19 Lockdowns on Venture Capital Investment Around the World
authors: Pengfei Han; Liu Chunrui; Xuan Tian; Kexin Wang
eligible_reason: Main DiD (Table 2, Figure 3, Tables 5-11) uses treat_post = high-mobility-restriction country x post-pandemic, with post = 1 for deals in 2020-2021 for every treated country (COVID19_and_VC_Startup_Distance.dta: treat_post is 0 in 2017-2019 and positive in both 2020 and 2021): a single common adoption date, not staggered. All columns also include time-varying controls (VC age, startup age, country GDP growth, patents). Tables 3-4 (China, deal-level, province lockdown dates) are triple differences: distance on covid_lockdown, covid_before, covid_reopen plus before/lockdown/reopen main effects with 355 day dummies, comparing 2020 to the same calendar days in other years; several treatment regressors in every column, so not a single-binary staggered TWFE design either (5b: triple differences with additional staggered regressors are not eligible). Table 1 is year-dummy descriptive regressions.
design_notes: Stata areg distance treat_post [controls] i.year [i.industry i.roundnumber i.quarter], absorb(vc) vce(cluster country); Figure 3 event study with treat_year1-4 (treat x year). Deal-level data (76,434 deals, 49 countries, 2017-2021). Tables 3-4: vcemway areg with two-way clustering by startup and VC province, 10,622 Chinese deals. Tables 5-7 add continuous moderators (internet latency, information asymmetry, deal size) in triple interactions.
data_files_note: Analysis-ready datasets for every table are shipped (derived from Refinitiv VentureXpert, OxCGRT, World Bank, Ookla, Compustat); raw licensed inputs are not.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Treatment timing checked in the shipped data: one post period (2020+) for all treated countries.
